{{Top|leg}}
'''Steristeel''' was a metal used in surgical implements.

==Behind the scenes==
The word ''steristeel'' is a portmanteau of sterile (used here to mean ''devoid of life or biological contaminants'' rather than ''unable to procreate'') and steel.
